segments.text: So I lost 15 pounds in 20 days and I'm going to tell you exactly how I did it.
I'm Bray. I'm a fitness specialist and I just want to help you reach your goal because
it's really not that hard. First things first, it's all mental. If you think you can do it,
you can do it. If you don't think you can do it, you're not going to be able to do it. So
you need to be able to be stronger than the voice that's in your head that's telling you
go eat that burger, go get Chick-fil-A. You got to be stronger than that, okay?
Second thing, you need to eliminate your sugar addiction. If you didn't know, your body runs
off sugar, aka glucose. So if you stop feeding yourself sugar, your body will burn the sugar
that is stored. Next thing, you need to be drinking a hundred ounces of water a day.
Really, you should be drinking your body weight in ounces, but a hundred ounces will do because
you didn't know your body actually flushes out the fat cells through your bloodstream,
and you pee it out. You don't poop it out. I literally thought you poop out the fat,
but you pee out the fat, okay? So that's why you need to stay hydrated with a hundred ounces of
water. But if you need a detailed list on what to eat, what foods to avoid, what time to eat,
how much to eat. I have that all in a meal plan on my website under a fat loss guide and honestly
those are the three things that help me lose 15 pounds in 20 days because I decided that I rather
be uncomfortable for 20 days rather than 20 years in my own body so the choice is really up to you.
Go ahead and check it out and I wish you the best on your journey.
